extracted.name: Apple-spice Quick Muffin (from All-purpose Baking Mix)
extracted.description: 9 net carbs Recipe from Wheat Belly Cook Book **Follow the recipe for All-purpose Baking Mix that I have to make this. **This has a nice balance of spices making it quite tasty with butter smeared on top!
instruction_lines: In med. bowl, combine baking mix, cinnamon, nutmeg, sweetener and salt.
Whisk in egg. Add applesauce and butter. Mix well.
Transfer mixture to large mug or 10 oz ramekin.
Microwave on high power 2 min. or until toothpick inserted comes out clean. Allow to cool 5 min.
